Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
refactor: replace basic-auth with Supabase founder-allowlist gate (#6)

* refactor: replace basic-auth with Supabase founder-allowlist gate

Swap the sitewide HTTP basic-auth gate for the same Supabase login flow as
the AIOS acquisition tracker (magic-link + Google), scoped founder-only via
an ALLOWED_EMAILS allowlist. Edge middleware validates the session
server-side and checks the email before serving — the financial HTML is
never returned to an unauthenticated/unauthorized browser (same edge-gate
property as the old basic-auth). Adds login.html + auth/callback.html.
Dependency-free middleware; reuses the shared internal Supabase project
(auth only). ACME /.well-known exemption preserved. DASH_AUTH retired.

Middleware verified against real minted sessions (allowlisted, non-allowlisted,
no-cookie, public paths, chunked-cookie reassembly).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: harden auth middleware + callback per review

- middleware: guard decodeURIComponent against malformed cookies (an uncaught
  throw would 500 the edge gate and break login); exempt /favicon.ico from the
  redirect-to-login path
- callback: on an explicit provider error, bail without also wiring up the
  session listeners (avoids racing redirects)

Re-verified against real minted sessions incl. malformed-cookie cases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
refactor: decouple auth onto dedicated Supabase project (magic-link only) (#7)

* refactor: decouple auth onto dedicated Supabase project, magic-link only

Move auth off the shared aios-acquisition-tracker Supabase project onto a
dedicated project (aaa-run-rate-auth, jbixotucnqhodoqmfsfw) so the founder
finance dashboard no longer rides another app's auth lifecycle.

Drop Google sign-in: the only existing Google OAuth client lives in the
aaa-aios (flagship) GCP project, and reusing it would re-introduce the
cross-project coupling this change removes. Magic-link is the same security
with no GCP/AIOS dependency. Edge allowlist gating is unchanged.

* chore: drop stray supabase/.temp from repo; gitignore it
